d:
The political equation between the Samajwadi Party (SP) and Congress in Uttar Pradesh is becoming increasingly complicated as discussions over seat-sharing gather momentum ahead of the upcoming Assembly elections.
While Rahul Gandhi is repeatedly emphasizing the importance of the alliance and demanding a respectable seat-sharing arrangement, Akhilesh Yadav appears to be taking a more cautious approach. The proposed coordination committees, Priyanka Gandhi's reported decision to stay out of the initial negotiations, and the delay in formal talks have added another layer of uncertainty.
